constraints: Capture the checkout VirtualService destination host and subset.

Scope is limited to checkout routing between the VirtualService, DestinationRule, and matching checkout pods; the mesh control plane and ingress gateway are not implicated.

payload.rationale: The VirtualService sends checkout traffic to subset v2, but the DestinationRule defines only v1 and both ready endpoints are labeled version=v1. Patch only the route subset to v1; this preserves the mesh, workloads, Service, and persistent data. Recovery must be confirmed by live ingress SLO probes because no baseline probe samples were collected.
payload.rollback_trigger: Roll back immediately if the patch is malformed, changes routing beyond the observed single checkout route, or produces a new or worse regression attributable to v1 routing; otherwise continue diagnosis if the required live SLO windows do not pass.

success_criteria.description: After Istio configuration propagation, live requests through the registered checkout ingress probe satisfy HTTP 5xx rate < 0.001 and p95 latency < 200 ms for 3 consecutive windows; configuration inspection alone is insufficient to declare recovery.
